source.name: 上游财经-重庆晨报 via 网易号 (Upstream Finance–Chongqing Morning Post via NetEase): 西南证券牵手重庆铜梁龙 共赴中超新征程
source.quote: 西南证券成为该俱乐部2026赛季独家首席合作伙伴及球衣胸前广告赞助商
source.note: Translation: 'Southwest Securities became the club's 2026-season exclusive chief partner and jersey chest-ad sponsor.' The page carries the byline 上游财经-重庆晨报记者 廖平 (reporter Liao Ping, Chongqing Morning Post) and reports the 12 March 2026 signing ceremony where the new shirt bearing the Southwest Securities logo was displayed. Corroborated by Tencent News' 17 March 2026 survey of all 16 CSL chest ads (https://view.inews.qq.com/a/20260317A0862Q00): “重庆铜梁龙足球俱乐部的胸前广告是“西南证券（600369.SH）””.

source.name: 虎扑体育 via 腾讯新闻 (Hupu Sports via Tencent News): 铜梁龙新赛季球衣：诠释重庆对足球的滚烫激情和豪迈血性
source.quote: 今日上午，耐克官方公布了2026中超联赛各队球衣，重庆铜梁龙球衣如图。
source.note: Translation: 'This morning Nike officially unveiled the 2026 Chinese Super League kits for every team; Chongqing Tonglianglong's kit pictured.' Kit maker, not a shirt-sponsor placement; listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers.

summary: 2026 CSL home kit (first top-flight season), Nike 'Chongqing red' (主场重庆红), unveiled 28 January 2026 as part of Nike's league-wide 2026 release. Front-of-shirt sponsor is 西南证券 (Southwest Securities), the club's 2026-season exclusive chief partner and chest-ad sponsor, announced 12 March 2026. No back, sleeve or shorts sponsor could be documented from sources we could open — no press report or club post names any other 2026 shirt sponsor — so the list is not marked complete.
